briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward AGI benchmarks amid record funding

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models in July 2026. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multi-agent orchestration capabilities. Anthropic's Claude 4 and xAI's Grok-3 follow closely behind in benchmark performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement actions target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell clusters now power 60% of new training runs. Microsoft and Google announced 50GW data center expansions for 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs by Q4 2026?
